[size=2]this mod?
this turns almost everything into pain. Have fun! :D

So, A ton of the stuff to craft needs other producers like needing a loom to make string. You can get most of this stuff from the community center, but some of the other stuff needs more than just the community center to be obtained. But I will let you figure this stuff out, because we can think. this also makes it harder to make giant money farms like most youtubers do, so you have to get creative to make bundles of cash.
[/size]
